description_en: Calls the IndexVideo operation to add a video to a media set and automatically perform frame extraction, grouping, and recognition on the video
description_zh: 调用IndexVideo接口将视频添加到媒体集中，并对视频进行自动截帧、分组、识别等操作
kebab_example: aliyun imm index-video --project immvideotest --set-id videotest --video-uri oss://imm-test/testcases/video.mp4 --api-version 2017-09-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: IndexVideo

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the media set
parameters.name: set_id

parameters.help_en:
The OSS URI of the video.

The OSS URI follows the format `oss://bucket/object`, where bucket is the name of the OSS bucket in the same region as the current project, and object is the file path
parameters.help_zh:
视频的OSS URI。

OSS地址规则为`oss://bucket/object`，其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的OSS Bucket名称，object为文件路径
parameters.name: video_uri

parameters.help_en:
The remarks, which is a reserved filter parameter for users to record required information.

In scenarios such as search, you can use the specified value as a search condition with prefix matching. The following are example scenarios:

Store the value as a relative path on the client, such as nas://path/to/file

在搜索等场景下，您可以以前缀匹配的方式将设置的值作为搜索条件，样例场景如下：

parameters.help_en: The TopicName for asynchronous reverse notification
parameters.name: notify_topic_name

parameters.help_en:
The endpoint for asynchronous reverse notification. Video processing results can be asynchronously sent to the invoker through this endpoint. To use this feature, activate Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS) first, create a topic and a queue, and configure the subscription relationship. For more information, see Quick start overview of Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS) (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/34412.html).

Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS) and Intelligent Media Management must be in the same region
parameters.help_zh:
异步反向通知的Endpoint，视频处理结果可以通过该Endpoint异步通知给调用者。使用此功能需要先开通轻量消息队列（原 MNS）服务，新建topic和queue，并配置订阅关系。具体操作，请参见轻量消息队列（原 MNS）快速入门概述 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/34412.html)。

轻量消息队列（原 MNS）服务和智能媒体管理必须处于同一地域
parameters.name: notify_endpoint

ModifyTime.description_en:
The modification time of the video.

After a video is added, if the video has not been modified, the modification time is the same as the time when the video was added to the media set
ModifyTime.description_zh:
视频的修改时间。

添加视频后，如果未修改过视频，则视频的修改时间和视频加入媒体集的时间相同
